notes:
- Background: adtech personalization engine; serving user-level ranking + short-form conversational prompts in same request path.
- Primary constraint: p95 end-to-end latency target 40-70ms for homepage recommendations; burst to 600 rps at peak.
- Cost sensitivity: current infra on managed GPUs ~2.4x token cost vs target. CFO wants quantization + batching to reduce inference cost by >=50% before long-term commit.
- Model preference: prefer open models; evaluating 13B quantized (int4/int8) for production, 7B as fallback. Want Redwood to show perf delta 7B-q vs 13B-q for our payloads.
- Caching: interested in prefix/KV caching for recurring user queries and session warm pools. Keen on transparent cache hit metrics in Console.
- Batching: want smart per-route batching to lower cost but keep tail latency — target average batch delay <6ms.
- Perf requests: asked for a standard benchmark script (we provided sampling of request distribution). Need Redwood to run against hosted vs dedicated vs private to compare.
- Security: must pass SOC2 + SSO/SAML + KMS integration; EU data residency for EU traffic. On-prem option desirable for regulated advertisers.
- Quote from CTO (call 2026-03-09): "If you can prove p95 under 70ms on our real traffic with half the cost, we'll greenlight Dedicated for Q2 commit."
- Meetings: discovery call (2025-11-19), architecture workshop with infra (2025-12-07), security deep dive (2026-02-28), perf run kickoff (2026-03-09).
- POC plan: 2-week parallel perf runs, quantized model images, caching policy A/B, cost/latency dashboards. See drive links.
- Risks noted in call: sampling script doesn't fully cover long-tail sequences; need warm KV cache for fair comparison.
- Sales notes: heavy championing by Head of ML (Eva Lin) but procurement lags due to existing vendor contracts.
- Next internal ask: SE to provide reproducible benchmark harness + recommended batch sizes and quantization profiles by 2026-03-17.
